text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. In the library, Biwa Hayahide seemed
to be troubled by something, so I called out to her—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm scheduled to read picture books aloud for an extracurricular study soon—but none of them feel quite right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. Fairy tales and folklore often contain things quite divorced from reality, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"When I read them, I can't help but get bothered
by the parts that don't hold up theoretically."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Even when it's explained to me,
it still doesn't quite click."
choice_data_list: Could you actually show me how it's done?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
True, that seems faster.
Let's use 'Momotaro' as an example, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Once upon a time, long, long ago—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"‘The old woman, having found a giant peach,
decided to take it back home.’"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "And together with the old man, she decided to cut open the peach. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It's from here.
This is the part I just can't get out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I did find it a bit strange when a giant peach
came floating down the river, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And right here, the astonishing truth is revealed: Momotaro was actually inside the peach!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Considering the circumstances, they must have been
inside the peach for at least tens of minutes to an hour.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why did Momotarou
not suffocate...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
After that, the old man and the old woman
cut the peach cleanly in half, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why was Momotaro unharmed?
Did they cut it carefully so as not to hit Momotaro?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that would be nearly impossible.
Since neither of the two knew about Momotaro's existence."
choice_data_list: Aren't you overthinking it a little?
Maybe you're overthinking it a bit?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, if it is not theoretically sound,
then it cannot be considered accurate knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Considering the children's future,
I want to avoid imparting any incorrect knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's expression shows total seriousness.
If she believes in it that strongly—
choice_data_list: Maybe you should try doing it your own way.
Maybe you could try doing it your own way.
Why not turn it into a study session instead?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's expression shows total seriousness.
If she believes in it that strongly—
choice_data_list: Maybe you should try doing it your own way.
Maybe you could try doing it your own way.
Why not turn it into a study session instead?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In my own way...?
choice_data_list: Maybe try pursuing logic to its conclusion?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Logically reconstructing the narrative, you say?
That might indeed be an interesting endeavor."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the story reading—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"‘The old woman, having found a giant peach,
decided to take it back home.’"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Noticing what appeared to be air holes pre-drilled into the peach,
the old woman grew suspicious and—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Together with the old man,
we decided to exercise the utmost caution and cut the peach open."

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
Air hole...?
Was there something like that...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If there weren't any air holes,
Momotaro wouldn't be able to breathe, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it'd be pitiful
if Momotaro were to suffer?

text_block_list.name: Precocious Child
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's so sad!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so someone kind must have left it open for us.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, let us continue the conversation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"From inside the peach emerged Momotaro in peak physical condition,
having had no trouble breathing at all."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Also, thanks to the elderly couple's caution,
it is said there were no injuries whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text: Momotaro, you're safe!

text_block_list.name: Precocious Child
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Good for you, Momotaro.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The picture book logically reconstructed by Biwa Hayahide caused a bit of confusion at first, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Ultimately, it seemed to have been a great opportunity
to give the children some food for thought."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see, a study session using picture books, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, even if it gets a bit explanatory,
I can tell you the issues and how to avoid them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's start preparing along those lines!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the picture book study session—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Those glass slippers Cinderella wears...
They look beautiful on the outside, but they're extremely dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Glass is hard, so there is a high chance
of injuring your feet while wearing them—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If by any chance a horseshoe were to shatter,
the fragments would fly everywhere, endangering those around them.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text: T-This is terrible~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That is why one should borrow shoes made from a safer material
rather than glass from the wizard.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When questioned by the wolf, Little Red Riding Hood
ended up revealing her purpose and the location of her grandmother's house.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If she had stayed vigilant and said nothing,
she could have prevented her grandmother from being swallowed whole.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If a suspicious person speaks to you, run away immediately—got it?

text_block_list.name: Precocious Child
text_block_list.text: Yeah, got it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, while the world of picture books is enchanting,
it can also harbor certain problematic elements.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"To make the most of one's life,
one should avoid trouble as much as possible."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Were you able to learn properly
through today's study session?"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
Biwa Hayahide's study session turned out to be a massive success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The children had taken a complete liking to her,
and she didn't seem to mind it one bit.
